verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an official MCP server and a Marketing Emails API, but nothing shows that either surface can create or define segments or lists from a plain-language audience description. Segment selection appears only as a UI step in the email editor. The campaign agent claim covers campaign planning, not programmatic segment creation, so the MCP server is only an adjacent building block here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can translate a plain-language audience description into a real segment via the platform's programmatic surface
